verdict.rationale: Luma documents its own Draft Mode, priced as a cheaper 360p tier at 20 credits for a 5s text-to-video or image-to-video clip, which covers the fast, low-cost drafting half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows a way to upscale or promote a chosen draft to final quality. Missing for 10: a documented upscale or draft-to-final step for a selected take, details on final-resolution output from drafts, and any hands-on corroboration of the workflow.

support.subject: As a creator, I can draft fast in a cheaper mode and upscale the chosen take to final quality

citations.quote: video-to-video with character reference and keyframes, Draft Mode, HDR pipeline
